categories.description: Tumor > 2 cm but ≤ 4 cm in greatest dimension
Tumor > 4 cm in greatest dimension or extension to lingual surface of epiglottis
Tumor of any size invading adjacent organ(s), such as larynx, extrinsic muscle of tongue, medial pterygoid, hard palate or mandible

notes.larynx: Mucosal extension to lingual surface of epiglottis from primary tumor of the base of tongue and vallecula does not constitute invasion of the larynx.

categories.description: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed

notes.node_count: Per AJCC 8th edition, a selective neck dissection ordinarily includes 10+ lymph nodes and a comprehensive neck dissection (radical or modified radical) ordinarily includes 15+. Negative pathologic examination of a smaller number of nodes still mandates a pN0 designation.

categories.description: Clinical classification: stage assigned from imaging, endoscopy, biopsy, and clinical exam before any definitive treatment.
Pathological classification: stage assigned from the surgically resected specimen after histologic review.
Classification determined during or after the application of initial multimodal (neoadjuvant) therapy.
No neoadjuvant therapy preceded this assessment.

notes.matching: For HPV-mediated oropharyngeal SCC AJCC 8, no separate ypTNM stage table is defined; DescY does not affect the stage outcome.

categories.description: Recurrent tumor classification, assigned when the tumor is staged after a disease-free interval.
